title: Installing and running DDS AutoDiag
keywords: autodiag install installation setup pip venv python3-venv docker image ghcr run start systemd service how to start
text: Install from the repository: sudo apt install python3-venv, git clone the repository, source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash, python3 -m venv --system-site-packages .venv, source .venv/bin/activate and pip install . (add ".[cloud]" for Claude). Then dds-autodiag doctor checks the machine and dds-autodiag serve --open starts the dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:8080. Without installing, use Docker: docker run --rm --net=host --ipc=host ghcr.io/animesh2507/dds-autodiag:0.1.0 (dashboard) or append check for a one-shot check; --net=host and --ipc=host let it see the same ROS graph and shared memory as your nodes. A systemd user service is included under deploy/.
